content:
mira: starting a canary for model v2-quant8 -> 5% traffic for chat-prod. quick summary: offline eval shows small quality drop, p95 latency +12ms. proposing: hold at 5% and run 24h A/B with 1k live eval prompts. auto-rollback rules suggested below. any objections? :eyes:

sam: can you paste the exact metrics and CI? need to know sample sizes and whether the -1.3% is statistically significant. also what's the baseline and which metric (exact_match / rouge / acc)?

juan: did an offline run earlier on 5k curated prompts (mix of chat, code, safety). results: mean exact_match -0.9%, median unchanged, regressions concentrated in code-gen snippets (top failure modes: truncated completions + confidence miscalibration). latency: median +4ms, p95 +12ms. no increase in 5xx in staging.

mira: baseline = v1. metric used = exact_match on our eval set (1k safety-focused, 4k general). here's the rollout config I'm thinking of (monitoring agent will compare rolling windows):

```
{ "canary": 0.05, "monitoring": { "metric": "exact_match", "baseline": "v1", "rollback_threshold_pct": -1.0, "min_consecutive_window_mins": 30, "evaluation_window_mins": 10 }, "fallback": ["v1"] }
```

mira: auto-rollback semantics: if metric delta <= rollback_threshold_pct for min_consecutive_window_mins AND traffic-weighted p-value < 0.05, then route traffic back to fallback. also immediate fallback on latency p95 increase > 50ms or error-rate spike > 0.5%.

olivia: +1 to using p-value check but let's also require minimum N per window (e.g., 200 requests) before triggering. otherwise noisy windows will flip. recommend Bayesian posterior overlap check as secondary signal. :spiral_calendar: schedule canary for 24h.

sam: propose staged ramp if we pass: 5% -> 20% -> 50% with 30m hold and sanity checks at each step. also add a canary-tagged alert to #eng-oncall if any rollback rule fires.

deploy-bot: Canary started by mira at 2026-03-19T14:12:47Z (thread_ts=1891234567). routing: 5% -> v2-quant8, monitor windows = 10m, alert channel = eng-oncall.

juan: quick note — quant artifacts show larger variance on long-token prompts. suggest we add a targeted probe set (length > 250 tokens) to the live eval and watch for tail regressions.

mira: good point. adding that probe set now. also storing KV-cache hit rate per model variant to catch perf regressions related to cache eviction.

olivia: can we also enable a soft-fallback path where the router falls back to v1 for requests with high safety score delta? e.g., if model confidence drops on safety triggers route to fallback immediately.

sam: assigned to run the A/B significance checks and produce a pass/fail report after first 6 hours. if anything fails, we rollback automatically per the config.

mira: decision: hold at 5% for 24h, run targeted long-token probes, require min N=200 per 10m window and p-value < 0.05 + delta <= -1.0% to trigger rollback. sam will report at +6h. thanks all. :thumbsup:
